fix1.resolution: corrected the claim (no runtime exactness check added)
fix1.exactWording: Required services are closed at the TYPE level - the Layer.Layer<CompositionServices, never, never> annotation cannot type-check if the graph still requires an ambient service. This is NOT graph exactness: because ROut is contravariant, a layer may provide EXTRA services without a type error, and an untyped Context.getUnsafe read could still reach an ambient context. Extra providers and untyped reads are NOT prevented; no runtime exactness check runs.
fix1.documentedLimitation: mutation (b): an extra provider still typechecks; untyped Context.getUnsafe reads are ambient. Both are now stated, not prevented.

fix2.control: one shared memo map (Layer.makeMemoMap) + one shared Scope, four builds inside that single scope: shared layer built twice -> same instance; Layer.fresh(shared) built twice -> different instances. Deleting Layer.fresh makes the 'different' assertion fail.

fix3.bound: total waiters are bounded: at most providerMaxWaiters callers park; beyond that a typed ProviderPermitOverflowError is returned (stats.rejected counts them). No caller waits on Semaphore's unbounded waiter list anymore.
fix3.test: 2,000 callers with providerMaxConcurrent=2 and providerMaxWaiters=2: during { active: 2, queued <= 2, rejected: 1996 }, after gate { completed: 4, rejected: 1996, active: 0, queued: 0 }, failure exits = 1996

red.mutation: reject replaced with blocking Semaphore.take(waiterSlots) (unbounded parking again)

Failing-user test: fail then succeed, active 0/completed 1 between them. Interrupted-user test: interrupt the holder, active returns to 0/completed 1, a later withPermit succeeds.

red.mutation: acquireUseRelease replaced with flatMap + success-only release
red.result: failing-user test times out because the permit is never returned (second acquire blocks)

fix5.exactWording: Scope of the 13 services (R27): this is the OWNER SHAPE only. It names R27's owner services plus the shared authorities, but it does not model early readiness/partial shutdown, cache identity, per-run judge/throttle isolation, or benchmark cancellation. Do not read the service set as R27 complete; those behaviours still need their own shape and tests.
